en.headline: Police to patrol Wan Chai round the clock ahead of APEC finance ministers meeting
en.dek: Hundreds of officers will cover the district from Friday as delegates begin arriving for the October 19-21 gathering at the Convention and Exhibition Centre.
body: Hong Kong police will carry out 24-hour patrols in Wan Chai from Friday as part of enhanced security arrangements for the APEC Finance Ministers’ Meeting, the South China Morning Post reported.

Delegates from the 21 member economies are expected to begin arriving as early as Friday for preparatory work, with most ministers not due until Sunday at the earliest. They will stay at several top hotels in the district, including the Grand Hyatt and Renaissance Harbour View.

The meeting itself will take place at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre from October 19 to 21, with a drafting session for the joint statement scheduled for Monday. Sources told the newspaper that hundreds of officers would be deployed around the clock in the area.

zh.headline: APEC財長會議將至 警方周五起灣仔24小時巡邏
zh.dek: 數百名警員由周五起在灣仔區全日巡邏，迎接即將抵港的代表，會議19至21日在會展中心舉行。
body: 據《南華早報》報道，香港警方將由周五起在灣仔區進行24小時巡邏，作為亞太經合組織財長會議加強保安安排的一部分。
21個成員經濟體的代表最早周五已開始抵港處理預備工作，大部分部長則預計最快周日才到。他們會入住區內多間高級酒店，包括君悅酒店及萬麗海景酒店。
會議本身將於10月19至21日在香港會議展覽中心舉行，周一先有聯合聲明起草會議。消息人士向報章表示，當局會在區內全日部署數百名警員。
